description: This file contains API functions for authentication processes such as registration, login, token refresh, and logout, including token extraction and normalization logic.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from various possible backend response shapes.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token string by removing 'Bearer' prefix and handling null/undefined strings.

methods.name: safeSetTokens
methods.description: Stores tokens only if they are valid non-empty strings.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant user by sending email and password to backend.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login, clears old tokens, stores new tokens if valid, and returns response data.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens by sending refresh token to backend and updating stored tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token on the backend.
